io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.api.recipes

Class SimpleCustomRecipe

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.api.recipes.SimpleCustomRecipe
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    CustomRecipe, org.bukkit.inventory.Recipe

    public class SimpleCustomRecipe
extends java.lang.Object
implements CustomRecipe
    Simple one-to-one mapping of an ingredient to a result. See ShapelessCustomRecipe for a class which supports multiple ingredients and results.
